# Additional native music platform adapters

`src/ui-bridge/additional-music-bridge.cpp` adapts protocol information from:

- [MakcRe/KuGouMusicApi](https://github.com/MakcRe/KuGouMusicApi): MIT, copyright 2023 MakcRe. References: `module/search.js`, `login_qr_key.js`, `login_qr_check.js`, `top_playlist.js`, `user_playlist.js`, `playlist_track_all.js`, `song_url.js`, `util/helper.js`, and `util/request.js`.
- [guowenye/qishui-api](https://github.com/guowenye/qishui-api): MIT, copyright 2026 arrow. References: `src/qishuiClient.js` and `src/normalizers.js`.
- [GSQZ/qishui-music-api](https://github.com/GSQZ/qishui-music-api/tree/924add376cadf8a2268f11999051eb976e3b8e0d): version 0.2.2, MIT, copyright 2026 sayqz. Native adaptations of `src/auth.cjs`, `protocol.cjs`, `client.cjs`, `catalog.cjs`, and `playback.cjs` in `additional-music-bridge.cpp/.h` and `qishui-protocol.h`, modified by QUEQIAN on 2026-11-14. Retained text: `qishui-car-MIT.txt`.

The license texts are preserved beside this file. No JavaScript service or public API relay is bundled. Qt sends requests directly to each platform. Account state is stored separately per platform inside the selected Relaxer data directory, using the existing Windows credential protection helper.

The adapters are an initial integration, not a claim of full API compatibility. Platform changes, account permissions and region restrictions can affect availability. Qishui encrypted audio, its daily mix, and the new platforms' artist/album search and AI recommendation are not implemented. Protected audio is never reported as a completed download. The car-protocol playback path prefers full plaintext resources and can play explicitly labelled plaintext previews when full audio is unavailable; it does not implement key extraction or CENC decryption. Previews are not saved as completed full-song downloads.

2026-11-14 follow-up, modified by QUEQIAN: compared the public `user_playlist.js` and ordinary request factory for gateway routing via `x-router`, plus Qishui `qishuiClient.js` passport cookie continuity, confirmed-session handling and PC account lookup. These are native Qt protocol adaptations; no JavaScript service, cloudlist AES service implementation, or new cryptographic dependency was copied. Real-account acceptance of this follow-up is pending.

Later real-account feedback showed Qishui passport error 1049, Kugou daily error 200103 and playlist HTTP 404. The new follow-up replaces the Qishui passport flow with the MIT car QR authorization/ticket protocol, including a fresh per-authorization P-256 CSR, DER ECDSA signatures using existing Windows CNG, account verification, expiry renewal and DPAPI persistence. It does not import another application's credentials. The old PC session cannot be migrated and needs a fresh QR sign-in. Catalogues use client tokens separately from signed account requests; playlist/song normalization follows car entities. Kugou v1.6.0 specifies an empty-body POST for daily recommendations and no `pubsongscdn` router on the public playlist path. Own playlists retain `listid` and use `/v4/get_list_all_file`; the working `/v7/get_all_list` catalogue is preserved. All changes await real-account/Harness acceptance.

Discovery source: [chthollyphile/folia-major](https://github.com/chthollyphile/folia-major/tree/52159848123ade84a4089d52aa28eeacff4117e6), AGPL-3.0. Inspected its package manifest and the Qishui/Kugou bridge files to identify the independently MIT-licensed dependencies above. No Folia implementation, assets, Electron persistence or UI was copied. No Node runtime, external relay, new crypto library or Folia dependency is shipped. This does not relicense Folia under GPL or imply all of Folia has the dependencies' MIT license.

The Kugou follow-up additionally adapts v1.6.0 `module/register_dev.js` and `util/crypto.js` in `additional-music-bridge.cpp` and `kugou-protocol.h`: synthetic client descriptors, `/risk/v2/r_register_dev`, AES-CBC device request/response and RSA-PKCS1 session envelope via existing Windows CNG/crypt32. Registration uses no real hardware inventory. Daily reads acquire a missing `dfid`; platform code 20028 can trigger one registration/retry. The resulting device credential stays with the DPAPI-protected platform session and never replaces token/userid from catalog responses. No node-forge or crypto-js implementation is copied or bundled.

2026-11-14 catalogue/artwork follow-up: Qishui account playlists now follow both MIT `src/catalog.cjs` reads (`/me/playlist/` and `/me/collection/mixed/`), walking opaque cursors and deduplicating playlist IDs. Native entity parsing accepts title/name, `display_info.url_cover`, `resource_cnt.track_cnt` and owner metadata; image prefixes are joined only when a directory prefix is returned, including the platform's template suffix. Kugou's MIT `module/audio.js` and `util/helper.js` provide the batch metadata request/signature used only for missing covers. Artwork fields in album/track metadata and template/filename CDN forms are normalized, without using uploader avatars as song covers. The existing MIT license covers these additional module references.

For interface shape comparison, also inspected Folia's `src/services/onlineMusic/qishui/qishuiNormalize.ts`, `qishuiCatalog.ts` and `kugou/kugouProvider.ts` at the fixed observation commit above. These files remain AGPL-3.0; only platform field names/request contracts were cross-checked. Their TypeScript functions and application implementation were not copied. The native Qt loaders, cancellation and queue/artwork updates are implemented in Relaxer; no Folia code or resources are distributed by this follow-up. Real-account confirmation remains pending.

Playback failure follow-up: rechecked the same MIT `src/playback.cjs`/`client.cjs` source for plaintext/full versus protected or preview resources, VOD play-info and candidate selection. The native parser additionally retains trusted backup URLs and safe error categories. Qishui failures stop the selected song after at most two transient retries instead of scanning the playlist automatically. This does not add protected audio decryption or claim every song has a usable full plaintext source; preview clips are still not promoted to complete tracks. No real-account playback acceptance was performed by the developer agent.

Playlist contract follow-up: user evidence showed error 28001035 while opening a recommendation. The public recommendation list was still read through `beta-luna.douyin.com/luna/discover/mix`, whereas every detail was being sent to the separate Car endpoint. Qishui playlists now retain an explicit Luna/Car origin marker, playlist type and owner. Luna recommendations use their matching `/luna/playlist/detail` request (`playlist_type`); Car account collections keep `/api/luna/v1/platform/playlist/detail/`. Old unmarked pinned records may try Luna detail once after Car returns exactly 28001035, without repeated retries or replacing IDs. This adapts the already-cited MIT `guowenye/qishui-api` `src/qishuiClient.js`/`normalizers.js` and GSQZ `src/catalog.cjs`; no precise undocumented meaning of 28001035 or real-account success is claimed. Account tickets are never sent to the anonymous Luna endpoint.

Preview follow-up supersedes the earlier full-only playback choice: at the user's explicit request, the native implementation now adapts the same MIT `src/playback.cjs` full-then-preview selection and `player.preview.duration` metadata. Both direct models and VOD play-info support preview playback. The resource's actual decoded duration drives progress, the source clip start offsets lyrics only, and preview state/clip metadata is retained with the online queue for restart. UI marks the current audio as a preview; a fragment is not counted as a complete play or downloaded under the full-song completion key. The former rejection was a Relaxer implementation choice, not a license requirement. All new changes await user/Harness confirmation.
